verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox documents self-service forwarding: users can request that letters or packages be forwarded to another address "with a few taps" from the phone app or web portal, which covers the one-click, no-support-email core of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows the richer controls the story asks for. The "Additional Recipient" article is about recipients on the mailbox, not saved forwarding addresses, so it earns no credit. missing for 10: rule-based or automatic forwarding, saved forwarding recipients/addresses, carrier choice, cost shown before confirming, independent or hands-on corroboration.
